## Games

### Rostock Seawolves extend winning streak to four games

*Played Saturday, 21 November 2026*

The Rostock Seawolves continued their winning streak to four games with an 86-67 victory over Science City Jena on November 21. TJ Crockett led the Seawolves with 18 points, while Zach Copeland added 14 points, 5 rebounds, and 5 assists. For Jena, London Perrantes scored 15 points and had 7 assists, but it was not enough to stop the Seawolves' winning streak. The Seawolves' defense was strong, holding Jena to just 21.4% from three-point range, while they themselves shot 51.7% from beyond the arc. The loss extends Jena's losing streak to six games, dropping them to the bottom of the table. The Seawolves, on the other hand, solidified their position in the top three of the table.

### Niners Chemnitz stun Gladiators Trier with 93-80 win

*Played Saturday, 21 November 2026* *(updated with new sources)*

Niners Chemnitz secured a 93-80 win over VET-CONCEPT Gladiators Trier in their last game before a two-week break for international matches. The Chemnitz team, led by Phlandrous Fleming Jr. with 22 points, 6 rebounds, and 6 assists, dominated the game from the start. Despite a strong performance from Trier's Marten Linßen with 9 points and EJ Onu with 8 points, Chemnitz's defense held strong, and they managed to pull away in the third quarter. Trier struggled with their three-point shots, making only 9 out of 37 attempts, while Chemnitz shot 24.3% from beyond the arc. The win marked a significant upset for Chemnitz, who had not won an away game in the BBL season so far. The Gladiators, who had been on a seven-game winning streak, suffered their first home loss of the season. The game was played on November 21, 2026, at 19:00 UTC.

### MHP RIESEN Ludwigsburg edge SYNTAINICS MBC 96:87

*Played Sunday, 22 November 2026*

MHP RIESEN Ludwigsburg secured a 96:87 win over SYNTAINICS MBC in a closely contested match. The home team, led by coach Carles Duran, had five players score in double digits, including Darius Perry with 18 points, Ishmael Leggett with 17 points, and Justin Kier with 15 points. For the visitors, Spencer Reaves led the way with 25 points, but was held to just 9 shots out of 33. The Ludwigsburg team outshot the visitors from the field, hitting 56% of their shots compared to 44% for the MBC. The win moves Ludwigsburg to 6-4 on the season, while the MBC falls to 6-4 with their second consecutive loss.

### Veolia Towers Hamburg edge out Phoenix Hagen in thriller

*Played Sunday, 22 November 2026*

Veolia Towers Hamburg secured a 97:94 win over Phoenix Hagen in a closely contested game. The match was marked by 12 lead changes in the second half, with neither team holding a lead of more than eight points. Jahvon Blair led the scoring for Hamburg with 27 points, including six three-pointers, while Osaro Rich set a new personal best with 17 points. Rich also became the Veolia Towers' record holder for most games played, surpassing Lukas Meisner's mark of 155 games. Chris Harris praised the energy and athleticism of Hamburg, saying that they presented a significant challenge to his team. Benka Barloschky, Hamburg's coach, expressed his respect for Hagen and Harris, and credited his team's ability to conserve energy as a key factor in their win. The victory was seen as a crucial one for Hamburg, who will now head into the national team break with momentum.

## European Cups

### Alba Berlin Comeback Victory in Nördlingen

Alba Berlin secured a 66:61 away win in Nördlingen, despite being down by 14 points at one stage. The team struggled to find their rhythm in the first half, but managed to turn the game around in the final quarter. Top scorer Deeshyra Thomas led the team's comeback, scoring 15 points. Alba Berlin will look to build on this momentum in their next game, a EuroCup away match against Braine on Wednesday, November 25.

Sources:

- [Alba Berlin: ALBA erkämpft sich Comeback-Sieg in Nördlingen](https://www.albaberlin.de/news/details/alba-erkaempft-sich-comeback-sieg-in-noerdlingen)

### Ludwigsburg falls to MHP RIESEN in easyCredit BBL matchup

Syntainics MBC suffered a 87:96 loss to MHP RIESEN on Sunday, with the team's 18th away game in the easyCredit BBL resulting in only four wins. The defeat dropped Syntainics to sixth place in the table, tied with Ludwigsburg on 12:8 points. The team will now take a two-week break for international games, with head coach Vladimir Jovanovic giving his players five days off. Top scorer Spencer Reaves scored 25 points, including 20 in the second half, while Anthony Gaines had a double-double with 9 points and 10 rebounds. The game was closely contested, with the lead changing 13 times before MHP RIESEN took control in the third quarter. Syntainics will next play at home against ALBA BERLIN on December 6 and in the ENBL against BC Jonava Hipocredit on December 9.

Sources:

- [Syntainics MBC: Der Ludwigsburg-Fluch hält an](https://syntainics-mbc.de/der-ludwigsburg-fluch-haelt-an)

### FC Bayern Munich win second rematch against ALBA Berlin 90:79

FC Bayern Munich secured their second win against ALBA Berlin this season, following their first victory in the previous matchup. The team's strong start in the second half, led by Vladimir Lucic and Rokas Jokubaitis, set the tone for the game. The Bayern Munich players netted three three-pointers in this period, which proved to be crucial in the game. Martin Hermannsson, the World Champion, had a standout performance, scoring 15 points, including a season-high five three-pointers. Hermannsson's contribution was notable, but he struggled to maintain his pace in the second half. The win marked a significant turnaround for the team, who had previously struggled in Berlin, particularly in the fourth quarter of their previous matchup. The 90:79 victory was achieved in front of 14,500 spectators at the Berlin arena.

## Around the League

### Alba Berlin Fall to Bayern in BBL Rematch

Alba Berlin suffered a 79-90 defeat to FC Bayern Basketball in the BBL rematch at the sold-out Uber Arena in front of 14,500 fans. The Berliners struggled to find their rhythm and momentum, particularly in the second half, and were unable to mount a successful comeback. Bayern, who had played four games in eight days, controlled the game and made the most of their opportunities, with a strong performance from the three-point line. Alba Berlin's coach Pedro Calles praised Bayern's victory, saying that his team had not been able to play at a consistent level throughout the game. Bayern's coach Anton Gavel was pleased with his team's performance, saying that they had found a good energy and had been able to take some players out of the game. Alba's captain Jonas Mattisseck acknowledged that his team had not been able to put enough pressure on Bayern and had allowed them to dictate the pace of the game.

Sources:

- [Alba Berlin: Vor 14.500 Fans in der ausverkauften Uber Arena: ALBA unterliegt Bayern](https://www.albaberlin.de/news/details/vor-14500-fans-in-der-ausverkauften-uber-arena-alba-unterliegt-bayern)

### Seawolves Women Extend Winning Streak to Five Games

The Rostock Seawolves women's basketball team extended their winning streak to five games with a 82:52 victory over BG Zehlendorf in the 1. Regionalliga Nord. The Seawolves dominated from the start, leading 22:7 after the first quarter and 47:23 at halftime. Paula Puzule led the team with 23 points, while Lara Brinkmann added 13. Coach Andrea Hoferichter praised her team's energy and unity, saying she was 'very proud' of their performance. The win keeps the Seawolves at the top of the league table, with five wins from five games.

- [Nordkurier: Fünfter Sieg in Folge: Seawolves-Frauen überrollen Gegner](https://www.nordkurier.de/sport/fuenfter-sieg-in-folge-seawolves-frauen-ueberrollen-gegner-5029337)

### Alba Berlin Falls to Bayern Munich in Prestige Duel

Alba Berlin lost to Bayern Munich 79-90 in the re-match of last year's final. The game was played in front of 14,500 fans in the sold-out hall in Berlin. Bayern Munich remains at the top of the table, while Alba Berlin falls to 9th place. Jordan Ford led Alba Berlin with 16 points, followed by Sam Griesel with 14. The game was closely contested in the first half, but Bayern Munich's high three-point shooting percentage in the first half gave them an advantage. Alba Berlin struggled with turnovers and foul shots, allowing Bayern Munich to maintain their lead. Despite a strong effort, Alba Berlin was unable to close the gap, and Bayern Munich secured the win.
